examples.sentence: 你的抽屉真乱，难怪/怪不得总是找不到东西。
examples.romanization: nǐ de chōuti zhēn luàn， nánguài/ guàibude zǒngshì zhǎobudào dōngxi。
examples.translation: Your drawer is really messy, no wonder you can never find [your] things.

examples.sentence: 他从来不操心孩子的事。这也难怪/怪不得，他那么忙，哪儿有时间啊。
examples.romanization: tā cóngláibù cāoxīn háizi de shì。 zhè yě nánguài/ guàibude， tā nàme máng， nǎr yǒu shíjiān ā。
examples.translation: He never concerns [himself] with his children’s problems (lit. matters). But that’s no surprise. He’s so busy, how could he find the time?

title: 与其……(倒)不如…… (Instead of… it’s better to…)
longExplanation: Instead of… it’s better to…. Pinyin: yǔqí……( dǎo) bùrú……

examples.sentence: 我想去上海、南京，杭州……总之想去南方转转。
examples.romanization: wǒ xiǎng qù Shàng Hǎi、 Nánjīng， Hángzhōu…… zǒngzhī xiǎng qù nánfāng zhuànzhuan。
examples.translation: I want to go to Shanghai, Nanjing, Hangzhou... In short, I want to go south.

examples.sentence: 他转过身，一句话也不说。
examples.romanization: tā zhuàn guò shēn， yījùhuà yě bù shuō。
examples.translation: He turned (his body) away, and didn’t say a word.

title: V 过 (V over, V by)
longExplanation: V over, V by. Pinyin: V guò

examples.sentence: 短短的几分钟里，我的脑子里闪过了很多想法。
examples.romanization: duǎn duǎn de jǐ fēnzhōng lǐ， wǒ de nǎozi lǐ shǎnguò le hěn duō xiǎngfǎ。
examples.translation: In as little as a few minutes, many thoughts flashed by my mind.

examples.sentence: 猴子突然站了起来，张开手臂抱住了管理员。
examples.romanization: hóuzi tūrán zhàn le qilai， zhāngkāi shǒubì bào zhù le guǎnlǐyuán。
examples.translation: The monkey suddenly stood up and opened his arm and hugged the zookeeper.

examples.sentence: 我下个月要搬家， 得赶快找房子。
examples.romanization: wǒ xiàgèyuè yào bānjiā， dé gǎnkuài zhǎo fángzi。
examples.translation: I have to move next month, I have to find housing quickly.
There is a cloud in the sky.

examples.sentence: 同学们听了，发出一片热烈的欢呼声。
examples.romanization: tóngxué men tīng le， fāchū yīpiàn rèliè de huānhū shēng。
examples.translation: The students listened and gave a (wave of) warm cheer.

examples.sentence: 我发现自己根本读不懂考试题。
examples.romanization: wǒ fāxiàn zìjǐ gēnběn dú bù dǒng kǎoshì tí。
examples.translation: I found myself unable to read the exam questions at all.
Education is the foundation of the country.
Things have been completely (lit. from the root) solved.

examples.sentence: 他根本就是在故意找我们的麻烦。
examples.romanization: tā gēnběn jiùshì zài gùyì zhǎo wǒmen de máfan。
examples.translation: He is simply trying to make trouble for us.

examples.sentence: 除非再给我一个星期，否则我们无法完成任务。
examples.romanization: chúfēi zài gěi wǒ yī gè xīngqī， fǒuzé wǒmen wúfǎ wánchéng rènwu。
examples.translation: Unless you give me another week, (otherwise) we can't complete the task.
